description: This file implements performance metrics tracing classes for plugin activation, deactivation, memory usage, and page load events within the WPEFramework plugin system. It defines classes for logging plugin and browser metrics, including enabling/disabling metrics, handling lifecycle events, and formatting trace output.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: A class for formatting and storing a performance metric message.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuput
classes.description: Implements plugin lifecycle and memory usage logging for plugin metrics.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuputBrowser
classes.description: Implements browser lifecycle and page load metrics logging.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables metrics logging by querying the memory interface from the service.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables metrics logging and releases memory interface.

methods.name: Activated
methods.description: Logs plugin activation and memory resident size.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Logs plugin resumed event and memory resident size.

methods.name: Suspended
methods.description: Logs plugin suspended event and memory resident size.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Logs page load completion, success status, and memory usage.
